title: Guard expanded recursive removal targets
why: An empty, split, or unexpectedly broad path expansion in rm -rf can remove data outside the intended target.
suggestion: Validate the target, require a non-empty expansion such as ${dir:?}, quote it, and avoid appending globs to unguarded variables.
limitations: Detection requires recursive and force flags plus an unquoted named parameter, an exact $@, $*, ${@}, or ${*} forwarding expansion, or an unguarded variable followed by a glob; quoted command substitutions are excluded.
Validation performed in earlier commands is not resolved.
